entries.en: Moss covered the damp stones inside the terrarium.
entries.zh: 植物栽培玻璃箱里的湿石头上长满了苔藓。

entries.en: The rudderless committee drifted from one proposal to another.
entries.zh: 那个缺乏方向的委员会在不同提案之间摇摆。

entries.en: The sculpture emphasised the athlete's muscularity.
entries.zh: 雕塑突出了运动员发达的肌肉。

entries.en: The manifesto proclaimed freedom an unalienable right.
entries.zh: 宣言宣布自由是一项不可剥夺的权利。

entries.en: She packed an antiperspirant with her other toiletries.
entries.zh: 她把止汗剂和其他洗漱用品一起装好。

entries.en: Wild grasses covered the uncultivated field.
entries.zh: 未经耕作的田地上长满了野草。

entries.en: He refused to vouchsafe even a brief explanation.
entries.zh: 他连一个简短的解释也不肯赐予。

entries.en: Harken to the bells echoing across the valley.
entries.zh: 听那回荡在山谷中的钟声。

entries.en: The car's defroster slowly cleared the icy windscreen.
entries.zh: 汽车除霜器慢慢清除了挡风玻璃上的冰霜。

entries.en: Unseasonable warmth brought the orchard into flower early.
entries.zh: 反常的暖天气使果园提前开花。

entries.en: The recorded delay was less than one msec.
entries.zh: 记录到的延迟不到一毫秒。

entries.en: The school's programme stressed the inculcation of good study habits.
entries.zh: 学校的计划强调反复培养良好的学习习惯。

entries.en: The archaeologist brushed soil from a painted potsherd.
entries.zh: 考古学家刷去了彩绘陶片上的泥土。

entries.en: Her allusive poetry rewards readers familiar with ancient myths.
entries.zh: 熟悉古代神话的读者能更好地欣赏她善用典故的诗歌。

entries.en: She shook flour through a metal sifter.
entries.zh: 她用金属筛子筛面粉。

entries.en: We walked beneath a grey, sunless sky.
entries.zh: 我们在灰暗无日光的天空下行走。

entries.en: He childishly refused to speak after losing the game.
entries.zh: 输了比赛后，他孩子气地不肯说话。

entries.en: His obliviousness to their earlier meeting puzzled her.
entries.zh: 他完全忘记了他们之前见过面，这让她很困惑。

entries.en: The teacher collected our classwork before the bell.
entries.zh: 老师在铃响前收走了我们的课堂作业。

entries.en: The lecture traced the release of vasopressin.
entries.zh: 讲座讲解了血管加压素的释放过程。

entries.en: The authority was statutorily required to publish an annual report.
entries.zh: 该机构依照法律规定必须公布年度报告。

entries.en: The detailed setting added believability to the fictional story.
entries.zh: 详尽的背景描写增加了这个虚构故事的可信度。

entries.en: The rhetorician held the crowd's attention without notes.
entries.zh: 那位雄辩家没有讲稿也牢牢吸引着人群的注意。

entries.meaningZh: 使用耸人听闻手法的人
entries.en: The critic accused the filmmaker of being a sensationalist.
entries.zh: 评论家指责导演惯用耸人听闻的手法。

entries.en: The expedition studied birds in a subarctic wetland.
entries.zh: 考察队研究了亚北极湿地中的鸟类。

entries.en: She swept the broken glass into a dustpan.
entries.zh: 她把碎玻璃扫进簸箕。

entries.en: His willfulness turned a simple disagreement into a prolonged argument.
entries.zh: 他的任性把一次小分歧变成了长时间的争吵。

entries.en: Her embryology course included detailed drawings of early development.
entries.zh: 她的胚胎学课程包括早期发育过程的详细图示。

entries.en: We cooked supper for a houseful of unexpected guests.
entries.zh: 我们为满屋子的不速之客做了晚饭。

entries.en: The investigation exposed exploitive conditions in the factory.
entries.zh: 调查揭露了工厂中存在剥削的工作条件。

entries.en: The sextet rehearsed in the empty concert hall.
entries.zh: 六重奏乐团在空荡荡的音乐厅里排练。

entries.en: He feared that his outdated training had made him unemployable.
entries.zh: 他担心过时的培训背景使自己无法再受雇。

entries.en: The puzzle presents a difficult combinatorial problem.
entries.zh: 这个谜题提出了一个困难的组合问题。

entries.en: The bugler stood beside the flagpole at dawn.
entries.zh: 黎明时，号手站在旗杆旁。

entries.en: The barkeep polished glasses behind the wooden counter.
entries.zh: 酒吧招待在木柜台后擦拭玻璃杯。

entries.en: The skeleton model had a removable humerus.
entries.zh: 那个骨骼模型的肱骨可以取下。

entries.en: The unsigned sketch was presumptively attributed to the same artist.
entries.zh: 根据合理推测，那幅未署名的素描被归于同一位艺术家。

entries.en: The survey recorded diarrheal illness in the affected villages.
entries.zh: 调查记录了受影响村庄中的腹泻疾病情况。

entries.en: She perceptively noticed the tension beneath his cheerful manner.
entries.zh: 她敏锐地察觉到他愉快举止下的紧张。

entries.en: The competition tested horsemanship as well as speed.
entries.zh: 比赛不仅考验速度，也考验马术。

entries.en: The study distinguished reflex responses from volitional movements.
entries.zh: 这项研究区分了反射反应与自主运动。

entries.en: The veterinary archive contained reports of scrapie outbreaks.
entries.zh: 兽医档案中保存着羊瘙痒病暴发的报告。

entries.en: The lamp's gooseneck bent easily towards the page.
entries.zh: 灯的鹅颈管可以轻松弯向书页。

entries.en: Thick fog began to enshroud the harbour.
entries.zh: 浓雾开始笼罩港口。

entries.en: The woebegone child stood beside his broken kite.
entries.zh: 那个愁眉苦脸的孩子站在坏掉的风筝旁。

entries.en: The memoir describes his prolonged struggle with hypochondria.
entries.zh: 回忆录描述了他长期与疑病症抗争的经历。

entries.en: The exhibit compared the teeth of an omnivore and a carnivore.
entries.zh: 展览比较了杂食动物和肉食动物的牙齿。

entries.en: The virologist examined samples collected from the bats.
entries.zh: 病毒学家检查了从蝙蝠身上采集的样本。

entries.en: She sent a note of commiseration after his disappointing result.
entries.zh: 他取得令人失望的成绩后，她寄去便条表示慰问。

entries.en: The new panels were tested thermally before installation.
entries.zh: 新面板在安装前经过了热性能测试。

entries.en: The historian examined jihadi rhetoric in the archived pamphlets.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了存档小册子中与圣战有关的论述。

entries.en: Her achy shoulders made the heavy backpack uncomfortable.
entries.zh: 她的肩膀隐隐作痛，背着沉重的背包很不舒服。

entries.en: The film's final scene erupts into chaotic gunplay.
entries.zh: 影片最后一幕爆发了混乱的枪战。

entries.en: The essay offered a rationalistic account of human knowledge.
entries.zh: 文章从理性主义角度解释了人类知识。

entries.en: His clownish movements delighted the children.
entries.zh: 他像小丑一样滑稽的动作逗乐了孩子们。

entries.en: She dipped a gingersnap into her tea.
entries.zh: 她把一块姜味脆饼蘸进茶里。

entries.meaningZh: 向法院作出的具结保证
entries.en: The old court record included a recognizance signed by the defendant.
entries.zh: 旧法院档案中有一份被告签署的具结保证书。

entries.en: He broke a breadstick beside his bowl of soup.
entries.zh: 他在汤碗旁掰开了一根面包棒。

entries.en: She righteously defended a colleague who had been falsely accused.
entries.zh: 她秉公维护了一位受到诬告的同事。

entries.en: The ratatouille simmered gently while we set the table.
entries.zh: 我们摆桌子时，法式蔬菜杂烩正小火炖着。

entries.en: An oldster at the club remembered the original pavilion.
entries.zh: 俱乐部的一位老人记得最初的那座亭子。

entries.en: The newspaper editorially supported the library expansion.
entries.zh: 报纸通过社论支持扩建图书馆。

entries.en: Comfrey grew thickly along the shaded garden fence.
entries.zh: 聚合草在花园背阴的篱笆边长得很茂密。

entries.en: The technician adjusted the luminance of the display.
entries.zh: 技术员调整了显示屏的亮度。

entries.en: The host greeted each late arrival genially.
entries.zh: 主人和蔼地迎接了每一位迟到的客人。

entries.en: The carpenter tested the sturdiness of the repaired chair.
entries.zh: 木匠测试了修好的椅子是否坚固。

entries.en: Multitudinous insects gathered around the bright porch lamp.
entries.zh: 无数昆虫聚集在明亮的门廊灯周围。

entries.en: The Scottish narrator longed for a home of his ain.
entries.zh: 那位苏格兰叙述者渴望拥有自己的家。

entries.en: We bought almond pastries at the corner patisserie.
entries.zh: 我们在街角的法式糕点店买了杏仁糕点。

entries.en: Procedural obstructionism prevented the committee from reaching a vote.
entries.zh: 程序上的蓄意阻挠使委员会无法进行表决。

entries.en: The museum's homepage features a photograph of its new gallery.
entries.zh: 博物馆主页展示了新展厅的照片。

entries.en: Her extroversion made her comfortable among unfamiliar guests.
entries.zh: 外向的性格让她在陌生宾客之间也感到自在。

entries.en: The painting shows a workingman carrying his tools home.
entries.zh: 画中，一个体力劳动者带着工具回家。

entries.en: A tremendous rumpus erupted in the room upstairs.
entries.zh: 楼上的房间突然喧闹起来。

entries.en: The chart distinguished parasympathetic pathways from sympathetic pathways.
entries.zh: 图表区分了副交感神经通路与交感神经通路。

entries.en: The pruner removed dead branches from the apple tree.
entries.zh: 修剪工剪掉了苹果树上的枯枝。

entries.en: The new timetable produced a sixfold increase in daily departures.
entries.zh: 新时刻表使每日发车次数增加到原来的六倍。

entries.en: Crossing the flooded bridge seemed inadvisable to everyone.
entries.zh: 大家都觉得穿过被水淹的桥不明智。

entries.en: She kept her passbook in a locked drawer.
entries.zh: 她把银行存折放在上锁的抽屉里。

entries.en: Each disputant was given five minutes to present an argument.
entries.zh: 每位争论者都有五分钟来陈述观点。

entries.en: The old engine coughed spasmodically before falling silent.
entries.zh: 旧发动机断断续续地噗噗响，随后沉寂下来。

entries.en: The programmer drew a flowchart before writing the code.
entries.zh: 程序员在编写代码前画了一张流程图。

entries.en: One stone baluster was missing from the staircase railing.
entries.zh: 楼梯栏杆上少了一根石支柱。

entries.en: It was neighbourly of her to clear our snowy path.
entries.zh: 她帮我们清扫积雪小路，真是很有邻里情谊。

entries.en: The actor made a kingly entrance in his velvet cloak.
entries.zh: 演员披着天鹅绒斗篷，以君王般的威严登场。

entries.en: The medical museum displayed early instruments used in rhinoplasty.
entries.zh: 医学博物馆展出了早期鼻整形术使用的器械。

entries.en: The seminar examined libidinal themes in the analyst's writings.
entries.zh: 研讨会研究了那位精神分析学者著作中的性欲主题。

entries.en: Unbeknown to us, the train had already departed.
entries.zh: 我们不知道，火车已经开走了。

entries.en: The psychology course introduced behaviorism through experiments on learning.
entries.zh: 心理学课程通过学习实验介绍了行为主义。

entries.en: The museum replayed footage of the astronaut's first moonwalk.
entries.zh: 博物馆重播了那名宇航员首次月球行走的影像。

entries.en: The noiseless door slid open as we approached.
entries.zh: 我们走近时，那扇门无声地滑开。

entries.en: The vast palace was designed to overawe visiting dignitaries.
entries.zh: 那座宏伟宫殿的设计意在震慑来访的显贵。

entries.en: A wooly caterpillar crossed the garden path.
entries.zh: 一只毛茸茸的毛虫爬过花园小径。

entries.en: She tucked her flyaway hair beneath a scarf.
entries.zh: 她把飘散的头发塞进围巾下面。

entries.en: The instructor warned us not to overstretch the elastic band.
entries.zh: 教练提醒我们不要把弹力带拉伸过度。

entries.en: The artist learned to foreshorten the figure's outstretched arm.
entries.zh: 艺术家学会了按透视法缩短人物伸出的手臂。

entries.en: He struggled manfully to keep the leaking boat afloat.
entries.zh: 他坚毅地奋力让漏水的小船保持漂浮。

entries.en: The tap dripped irritatingly throughout the quiet night.
entries.zh: 水龙头整夜滴水，在寂静中格外恼人。

entries.en: She emerged from the long dispute tired but unbowed.
entries.zh: 漫长的争端结束后，她虽疲惫，却没有屈服。

entries.en: The surgeon explained the colostomy using a plastic model.
entries.zh: 外科医生用塑料模型讲解了结肠造口术。

entries.en: The engineer compared resistive and capacitive sensors.
entries.zh: 工程师比较了电阻式传感器与电容式传感器。

entries.en: She chose anesthesiology during her final year of medical school.
entries.zh: 她在医学院最后一年选择了麻醉学专业。

entries.en: The traveller carried a small juju in a leather pouch.
entries.zh: 旅人把一个小护符装在皮袋里随身携带。

entries.en: The unfinished design remained betwixt and between.
entries.zh: 那个未完成的设计仍处于不伦不类的中间状态。

entries.en: The brochure began to vaunt the hotel's supposed exclusivity.
entries.zh: 宣传册开始夸耀酒店所谓的独享地位。

entries.en: They shared a bottle of zinfandel over dinner.
entries.zh: 晚餐时，他们一起喝了一瓶仙粉黛葡萄酒。

entries.en: Closing the workshop to save a little money was shortsighted.
entries.zh: 为了省一点钱而关闭作坊是目光短浅的。

entries.en: He tediously repeated every detail of the journey.
entries.zh: 他冗长乏味地复述了旅途中的每个细节。

entries.en: The faded signboard creaked above the shop entrance.
entries.zh: 褪色的招牌在商店入口上方吱呀作响。

entries.en: The inscription promised that her name would live evermore.
entries.zh: 碑文许诺，她的名字将永存。

entries.en: Breaking a promise for personal gain was dishonourable.
entries.zh: 为个人利益而违背承诺是不光彩的。

entries.en: The students assembled a simple galvanic cell.
entries.zh: 学生们组装了一个简单的原电池。

entries.en: The stronger runner began to outdistance the rest of the field.
entries.zh: 那位更强的选手开始把其他参赛者远远甩开。

entries.en: The tree's exfoliation left thin strips of bark on the ground.
entries.zh: 树皮成片剥落，在地上留下细条状的树皮。

entries.en: The jokes threatened to trivialise a serious discussion.
entries.zh: 那些玩笑可能会使一场严肃讨论显得无关紧要。

entries.en: The restored film is now viewable in the museum.
entries.zh: 修复后的影片现在可以在博物馆观看。

entries.en: The edition includes philological notes on unusual spellings.
entries.zh: 这个版本收录了关于特殊拼写的语文学注释。

entries.en: The old stove worked tolerably despite its damaged door.
entries.zh: 旧炉子虽然炉门损坏，但用起来还算不错。

entries.en: The cracks spread radially from the impact point.
entries.zh: 裂纹从撞击点沿半径方向扩散。

entries.en: They took the old convertible for a joyride.
entries.zh: 他们开着那辆旧敞篷车去兜风。

entries.en: The critic called the novelist a sentimentalist for that tearful ending.
entries.zh: 因为那个催泪结尾，评论家称小说家是感伤主义者。

entries.en: The class compared parasitism with relationships that benefit both species.
entries.zh: 课堂上比较了寄生现象与双方物种都受益的关系。

entries.en: The painting's heavy impasto caught the light along each brushstroke.
entries.zh: 画作厚涂的颜料沿每道笔触反射着光。

entries.en: The evidence exposed the accusation as insupportable.
entries.zh: 证据表明，那项指控无法合理成立。

entries.en: The dress shimmered with panels of blue moire.
entries.zh: 裙子上的蓝色波纹丝绸裙片闪着光。

entries.en: The treaty committed both neighbours to nonaggression.
entries.zh: 条约要求两个邻国都遵守不侵略政策。

entries.en: The committee's recalcitrance frustrated every attempt at compromise.
entries.zh: 委员会的顽抗使每次妥协尝试都受挫。

entries.en: He callously ignored the frightened child's request for help.
entries.zh: 他冷酷地无视了那个受惊孩子的求助。

entries.en: There was not a scintilla of evidence supporting the rumour.
entries.zh: 没有丝毫证据支持那则传言。

entries.en: The singer seemed uncomfortable with such idolatrous admiration.
entries.zh: 歌手似乎对这种盲目崇拜感到不自在。

entries.en: The soft whirr of the fan filled the room.
entries.zh: 风扇轻轻的嗡嗡声充满了房间。

entries.en: The child gazed adoringly at her older brother.
entries.zh: 孩子崇拜地望着哥哥。

entries.en: The orchestra played the adagio with remarkable restraint.
entries.zh: 乐团以极其克制的方式演奏了柔板乐章。

entries.en: The uniform layout seemed to depersonalize every room.
entries.zh: 统一的布置似乎让每个房间都失去了个性。

entries.en: The composer met the librettist to discuss the final scene.
entries.zh: 作曲家与歌剧脚本作者见面，讨论最后一场戏。

entries.en: She thoughtlessly left the gate open behind her.
entries.zh: 她疏忽地没关身后的大门。

entries.en: The awfulness of the accident silenced the crowd.
entries.zh: 事故的可怕情景使人群安静了下来。

entries.en: The waterproof case left the old documents unimpaired.
entries.zh: 防水盒使旧文件完好无损。

entries.meaningZh: 以色列货币单位；谢克尔
entries.en: The collector added a silver shekel to the display.
entries.zh: 收藏者往展柜里添了一枚银质谢克尔硬币。

entries.en: We left our soppy coats beside the kitchen fire.
entries.zh: 我们把湿透的外套放在厨房炉火旁。

entries.en: The spoiled liquid had become thick and ropy.
entries.zh: 变质的液体变得又稠又黏，能拉出丝来。

entries.en: The audit found evidence that he had tried to misappropriate company funds.
entries.zh: 审计发现了他曾试图挪用公司资金的证据。

entries.en: The poem's inwardness contrasts with the noisy public celebration.
entries.zh: 这首诗的内在精神性与喧闹的公共庆典形成对照。

entries.en: She spread tapenade onto slices of toasted bread.
entries.zh: 她把橄榄酱抹在烤面包片上。

entries.en: The seminar traced the history of anarchism in Europe.
entries.zh: 研讨会追溯了欧洲无政府主义的历史。

entries.en: He dismissed the exaggerated sales pitch as malarkey.
entries.zh: 他认为那套夸大的推销说辞纯属胡言。

entries.en: The passengers began to yammer about the delayed departure.
entries.zh: 乘客们开始喋喋不休地抱怨延迟出发。

entries.en: The historian compared polygynous households in two ancient societies.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了两个古代社会中的一夫多妻家庭。

entries.en: She tied her babushka neatly beneath her chin.
entries.zh: 她把三角头巾整齐地系在下巴下面。

entries.en: The farmer selected a capon for the holiday meal.
entries.zh: 农夫挑了一只阉鸡准备节日大餐。

entries.en: The landlord scandalously neglected the building for years.
entries.zh: 房东多年来令人愤慨地放任房屋失修。

entries.en: A tuneful song drifted from the open window.
entries.zh: 一首曲调优美的歌从敞开的窗户飘出。

entries.en: The proposal became unfeasible when the only bridge closed.
entries.zh: 唯一的桥关闭后，那个提案变得不可行。

entries.en: The sourness of the lemon balanced the rich sauce.
entries.zh: 柠檬的酸味平衡了酱汁的浓腻。

entries.en: Her disorganised notes made revision painfully slow.
entries.zh: 她杂乱的笔记让复习变得异常缓慢。

entries.en: A tall, rawboned farmer stood beside the gate.
entries.zh: 一位高个子、骨骼突出的瘦削农夫站在门旁。

entries.en: The test revealed the fabric's unsuitability for outdoor use.
entries.zh: 测试表明，这种织物不适合户外使用。

entries.en: Her unselfconscious laugh put the nervous guests at ease.
entries.zh: 她自然不做作的笑声让紧张的客人们放松了下来。

entries.en: The shop was quaintly decorated with clocks and painted teapots.
entries.zh: 店里用时钟和彩绘茶壶作了古雅而奇特的装饰。

entries.en: His uncharitable remark spoiled an otherwise pleasant evening.
entries.zh: 他那句不宽厚的话破坏了原本愉快的夜晚。

entries.en: During the wartime brownout, only carefully shaded lamps remained lit.
entries.zh: 战时实行部分灯火管制期间，只有经过严密遮光的灯仍亮着。

entries.en: The regime used cinema to propagandize its economic programme.
entries.zh: 那个政权利用电影宣传其经济计划。

entries.en: The museum reveals the workaday lives of ordinary sailors.
entries.zh: 博物馆展示了普通水手的日常生活。

entries.en: Her quiet departure went unremarked until breakfast.
entries.zh: 直到早餐时，大家才注意到她已经悄悄离开。

entries.en: The mineral sample contained pale layers of talc.
entries.zh: 矿物样本中含有浅色的滑石层。

entries.en: The study compared the compounds' immunosuppressive effects.
entries.zh: 研究比较了这些化合物的免疫抑制作用。

entries.en: They lived frugally while saving for a home.
entries.zh: 他们节俭生活，为买房积蓄钱。

entries.en: The philosopher defended monism against several objections.
entries.zh: 哲学家针对若干反对意见为一元论作了辩护。

entries.en: The anatomy model showed the pharynx behind the mouth.
entries.zh: 解剖模型展示了口腔后方的咽部。

entries.en: The council reserved the riverfront site for nonresidential development.
entries.zh: 市议会把河畔地块预留给非住宅开发项目。

entries.en: His moodiness made everyday conversations difficult.
entries.zh: 他的喜怒无常使日常交谈变得困难。

entries.en: The dancer wore a bluebonnet with a small feather.
entries.zh: 舞者戴着一顶饰有小羽毛的苏格兰蓝色扁帽。

entries.en: Her essay explained the doubts underlying her agnosticism.
entries.zh: 她的文章解释了自己持不可知论背后的疑问。

entries.en: The largeness of the hall made the piano look tiny.
entries.zh: 大厅的巨大衬得钢琴十分小巧。

entries.en: The family hosted a luau beside the beach.
entries.zh: 这家人在海滩旁举办了一场夏威夷式宴会。

entries.en: The tartness of the berries contrasted with the sweet cream.
entries.zh: 浆果的酸味与甜奶油形成对比。

entries.en: The philosopher asked whether consciousness could be nonmaterial.
entries.zh: 哲学家提出了意识能否是非物质的问题。

entries.en: The expert detected fakery in the supposedly ancient coin.
entries.zh: 专家发现那枚所谓的古币是伪造的。

entries.en: The dockworker secured the crate before it was lifted.
entries.zh: 码头工人在货箱起吊前将其固定好。

entries.en: The lecture examined policy debates during a period of stagflation.
entries.zh: 讲座考察了滞胀时期的政策争论。

entries.en: The clinical report noted an episode of hyperventilation.
entries.zh: 临床报告记录了一次过度换气发作。

entries.en: The story's deceiver wins trust before stealing the jewels.
entries.zh: 故事中的骗子先赢得信任，再偷走珠宝。

entries.en: The soil experiment measured nitrification under different moisture conditions.
entries.zh: 土壤实验测量了不同湿度条件下的硝化作用。

entries.en: The pale georgette scarf floated in the breeze.
entries.zh: 浅色乔其纱围巾在微风中飘动。
